recommendation_summary: Set up a single external dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings on successful completion and that emails the user if the daily heartbeat is missed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker infrastructure for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only after reaching its summary step, so a startup crash stays silent.
labels.Checked myself: Only the facts you supplied; I have not inspected the job or machines.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects Synology/Docker logging, and its record lines are specific and come before the recommendation.
